items.title: 15.1.1 Basic Elements of Nervous Coordination (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the basic elements of nervous coordination (PDF 26-27).

blocks.text: Homeostasis (jism ke andar halat ko barabar rakhna) ke liye nervous system sab se aham hai, kyun ke yeh doosre systems ko qaboo karta hai aur khud bhi homeostasis qaim rakhta hai. Aap homeostasis ke bunyadi hisse (basic elements) parh chuke hain. Yahan hum unhein nervous system ke hawale se parhenge.

items: Receptors: yeh woh aaza, tissues ya cells hain, jaise aankhein, kaan ya jild (skin), jo stimuli (muharrik, yaani bahar aur andar ke mahol ki tabdeeliyan) ko pakarte hain. Yeh transducers ka kaam karte hain. Jab inhein stimulus milta hai to yeh sensory neurons mein nerve impulses paida karte hain. Maloomat ko process karne ke liye sensory neurons nerve impulse ko central nervous system tak le jate hain.

Central nervous system: yeh nervous coordination ka control centre hai. Yeh dimagh (brain) aur spinal cord se bana hai. Yeh hisse associative neurons (jinhein inter-neurons bhi kehte hain) se bane hain. Yeh sensory neurons se nerve impulses lete hain aur unhein process karte hain. Process karne ke baad yeh motor neurons ke zariye effectors ko nerve impulses bhejte hain.

Effectors: yeh woh hisse hain jo central nervous system se motor neurons ke zariye aane wala nerve impulse mil kar jawab (response) dete hain. Muscles aur glands effectors ka kaam karte hain. Muscles sukar kar (contract ho kar) jawab dete hain, jabke glands ifraz (secretion) karte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Receptors transducers ka kaam karte hain kyun ke yeh tawanai (energy) ki ek shakal ko doosri shakal mein badalte hain. Maslan aankh ke retina ke rod aur cone cells roshni ki tawanai ko nerve impulse (electrochemical tawanai) mein badal dete hain.

To nervous coordination mein paigham (nerve impulse) ka raasta yeh hai: receptors, sensory neurons, central nervous system (inter-neurons), motor neurons aur effectors. Is raaste mein neurons functional units (kaam karne wali bunyadi ikaiyan) hain.

blocks.prompt: Garam pateele se haath hatate waqt paigham ka raasta batayein.
blocks.explanation: Jild ke garmi aur dard ke receptors, phir sensory neuron, phir spinal cord ke inter-neurons, phir motor neuron, aur aakhir mein baazu ke muscles (effectors) jo sukar kar haath hata lete hain.

items: Paigham ka raasta: receptor (transducer), sensory neuron, CNS (inter-neurons), motor neuron, effector (muscle ya gland).
